title: Handling check (development)
question: Drag a box onto the floor, then change its height with the handle beside it.
steps: Drag a box with one finger to another spot on the floor.
Drag the yellow handle beside the placed box up or down to change its height.
Press Drop boxes and see whether a raised box falls.
observe: You can't place a box where it overlaps another box or the blue block, or outside the floor.

law.title: The handling plane
law.description: While you drag, a box moves only on a plane parallel to the floor, and its height changes only with the handle.

tip: Drag a box with one finger to move it, then change its height with the yellow handle beside it.
